body.name: Cut-generator handle for general assignment kernels
body.construction: Starting move: for each \(x^a\in\mathcal M_N\), use \(x^a=x^a_1\mathbf 1_N+\sum_{r=1}^{N-1}(x^a_{r+1}-x^a_r)d_r\); insert these nonnegative adjacent increments into \(\mathscr L_{H,\Omega}\), quotient by \([\Omega]_{\cong}\), and seek a finite cut-product separation certificate for membership in \(\mathfrak C^{\mathrm{bal}}_{N,K}(H)\).
